decisions.subject: versioning
decisions.decision: All post-M0 Candidate, Publication, Story-State, Job HTTP/SSE and plugin lifecycle additions use the additive v2 roots and schemas. Existing v1 contract, SDK and api/v1 bytes are not reinterpreted or regenerated into v2.

decisions.subject: candidate-authority
decisions.decision: Candidate target, base and write_set are same-Workspace Core inputs. Parent candidates and source_refs may cross Workspace only as lineage/evidence. Candidate review is non-publishing; publication.accept is the sole publication route.

decisions.subject: partial-publication
decisions.decision: A normal partial Candidate is review-only. The only publishable partial form is the Core-generated incomplete_stream Candidate, whose frozen mutation is accepted through publication.accept after the same CAS and evidence checks.

decisions.subject: projection
decisions.decision: Story-State projection input is a closed, read-only projection of one Core-derived Publication, its Candidate, the current Revision, immutable Assets and a complete provenance receipt closure.

decisions.subject: job-cursors
decisions.decision: candidate, job and core cursors are disjoint domains. A job SSE recovery response reports cursor-ahead and replay-gap/snapshot recovery separately and never converts a candidate/core cursor into a job cursor.

decisions.subject: plugin-lifecycle
decisions.decision: Install, upgrade, retire and rollback are explicit Core lifecycle commands protected by operation_key and generation CAS. Plugin lifecycle has no publication capability; publication remains Core-owned.

implementation_note: The exact v2 route and DTO field inventory in this artifact is a P0 adjudicated minimum closed surface for the post-M0 gap. It is not claimed to be a verbatim extraction from formal design v1.2. The existing generators and verifiers remain the single contract pipeline.
